title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Taguimtim, Municipality of Dao, Province of Antique, to Paciencia
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Taguimtim, Municipality of Dao, Province of Antique, to Paciencia
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Taguimtim, Thị trấn Dao, Tỉnh Antique thành Paciencia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Taguimtim, เทศบาล Dao, จังหวัด Antique เป็น Paciencia
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Taguimtim, Kotamadya Dao, Provinsi Antique menjadi Paciencia
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Taguimtim, Perbandaran Dao, Wilayah Antique menjadi Paciencia

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_2043_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the barrio of Taguimtim, Municipality of Dao, Province of Antique, is hereby changed to Paciencia.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 23, 1957.
